t: The Matter Transmitter is a device that can teleport players to any other $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)Matter Receiver$(/l). Use the $(l:rftoolsbase:machines/dialing_device)Dialing Device$(/l) to dial a matter transmitter to a receiver.$(br2)$(5)Infusing$() this machine causes reduced power consumption and increased teleportation speed
物质传输器是一种可将玩家传送至任意其他$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/matter_receiver)物质接收器$(/l)的装置。请使用$(l:rftoolsbase:machines/dialing_device)坐标记录仪$(/l)将物质传输器拨号至接收器。$(br2)$(5)注魔$()该机器可降低能耗并提升传送速度。
